title: onoseris rupestris
intro: Onoseris rupestris, commonly known as the rocky onoseris, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various ailments such as wounds, skin infections, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Onoseris rupestris involve its ability to inhibit the growth of microorganisms, reduce inflammation, and protect cells from oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
